name: app-health
description: App Health V0 — endpoint health for Go and Node applications.

scripts.quality: pnpm --silent run format:check && pnpm --silent run quality:go-format && pnpm --silent run lint && pnpm --silent run typecheck && pnpm --silent run quality:go-vet && pnpm --silent run build && node scripts/verify-local-sdk.mjs && pnpm --silent run quality:coverage && pnpm --silent run quality:unused && pnpm --silent run quality:complexity && pnpm --silent run quality:duplication && pnpm --silent run quality:cycles && pnpm --silent run quality:dependencies && pnpm --silent run quality:suppressions && pnpm --silent run quality:hygiene
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @app-health/worker exec wrangler deploy --env="" --dry-run
scripts.d1:migrate:production: pnpm --filter @app-health/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env=""
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @app-health/worker exec wrangler deploy --env="" --tag "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
